📖 How to use

  1. Enter your gross pay per pay period and how often you are paid.
  2. Add your combined tax rates and any deductions.
  3. Read your net paycheck and annual take-home.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What tax rate should I enter?

Your effective rate (total tax ÷ gross income), not your marginal bracket. Check last year's return or a recent pay stub.

What are pre-tax vs post-tax deductions?

Pre-tax (401k, health premiums) reduce taxable income; post-tax (Roth 401k, garnishments) come out after tax. The tool taxes only gross minus pre-tax.

Why is this an estimate?

Real payroll uses progressive brackets, Social Security/Medicare caps and state rules. This flat-rate model is for planning.
